lines: Several PESU Scholarships are available for eligible students.
Merit Certificate + 50% Tuition Fee Refund for Top 5% of the Students based on their CGPA.
Merit Certificate + 40% Tuition Fee Refund for the next 20% of the Students based on their SGPA.
Merit Certificate for Students securing 7.75+ SGPA.
The Scholarships/ Awards are subject to qualifying CGPA/ SGPA and other conditions as stipulated by Scholarship Committee each year.
The above Scholarships/ Awards are not applicable to students in their final year of study.
The student is eligible only for one award in each semester/year.
Many corporates offer scholarships for our students in the final year of their education recognizing their merit
Students who display proven acumen towards teaching shall be compensated for assisting their Professors in teaching their students
Students showing keen research intent can work under Professor’s as research associates and can be compensated for it.
At PES, we shall recognize and honor only those students with scholarships who showcase their merit after joining us and not before they join us.
*Information presented above may be subject to change by the University.
